scope: Notebook 2, fixed initial chronological reference audit. Neither full-panel rolling ACD scores nor a final paper specification.
calendar: UTC: 56 initial days seasonal history, then 56 days model training, then 14 days validation. Validation is model-development data; later panel remains unused for these estimates.
seasonality: At each UTC day start use only prior 56 origin days matching weekday and 15-minute origin slot. Working scale = observed exposure seconds / completed events. Four prior exposed dates, 1800 exposure seconds, 100 completions and full-window warm-up required. Scale is frozen at spell origin.
seasonal_model: Exposure/event ratio is the MLE scale under a constant exponential working model for each origin cell, conditional on ignorable censoring. It is not an assumption-free estimate of mean latent durations. Dynamic ACD is fitted after this reference prefilter; simultaneous estimation and alternative seasonal specifications remain sensitivity questions.
historical_cutoffs: A spell running at a historical seasonal or model-training cutoff contributes only exposure up to that cutoff; its later endpoint event is unavailable. Events exactly at the cutoff are excluded from that historical fit. Origin-time scale remains fixed even if the wait crosses cells or dates.
observation_assumption: Density/survival contributions are a working ignorable-observation likelihood conditional on audited support. Freshness caps are deterministic elapsed-time rules for the recorded stream. Structural interruptions/removed quotes are not certified independent censoring, and omitted vendor updates remain unresolved. Reference fits do not identify latent market-wide arrivals.
recursion: y_i=elapsed_i/scale_at_origin; psi_i=omega+alpha*y_previous+beta*psi_previous after an observed completion in the same eligible sequence. Initialize psi=omega/(1-alpha-beta) at component or factor-availability/training-entry reset. No state crosses a censored terminal or unavailable factor.
distributions: EACD uses exponential mean psi. Weibull ACD uses shape k and scale psi/Gamma(1+1/k), so psi is the conditional mean in normalized units. Constant iid exponential is a reference using identical training and validation support.
likelihood: For event d, log contribution = d*log density + (1-d)*log survival. Raw-seconds completed log density includes -log(origin seasonal scale). Incomplete spells have no density Jacobian. Positive exposure only; zero exposure is bookkeeping. No clipping, winsorization, or uncensored-completions-only likelihood.
optimization: Three fixed starts. Analytic gradients checked by finite differences, omega>0, alpha,beta>=0, alpha+beta<0.999 reference ceiling. Weibull k in [0.2,5]. L-BFGS-B, max 150 iterations, ftol 1e-11, gtol 1e-6. All attempts and boundary flags saved; no global optimum guarantee.
validation: Parameters are frozen at the training cutoff. Recurrence filters prior observations and updates only after each recorded completion; the current wait cannot change its own psi. Origin-after-cutoff validation excludes a wait already running at cutoff, though its eventual completion can update later forecasts. Completed scores are available only at the later quote.
diagnostics: Cumulative hazard H gives martingale residual d-H under the working model. Hazard-band event counts are compared with integrated risk exposure; completed-only PIT uniformity is not assumed under censoring. Daily summaries and raw-seconds scores are descriptive, with no iid p-values.

diagnostic_flags.meaning: Fixed before execution, engineering screening tolerances only. Passing is insufficient for publication; failure blocks use as calibrated shock probabilities.

sensitivity: Structural-only Weibull also fitted without structural-terminal training contributions and with unit initial psi. These are isolated diagnostics; omitting tails is not a bias correction, and seasonal scales remain the common reference in these comparisons.

limits: UTC/local-session DST and holiday effects require sensitivity. No primary support policy is selected.
Reset initialization is a working approximation; the latent state after a gap may differ from the unconditional mean. Numerical admissibility does not establish economic stationarity.
Time resolution, vendor batching and unrecovered updates may violate a continuous duration distribution. Diagnose rather than hide the mismatch.
The first validation window cannot establish stability across the full panel or predictive economic content.
No shock detector, persistence label, state-dependent price response, causal interpretation or final inference is estimated.
